title: an app with answer buttons: its text is the size of the stage's own words and its buttons are a finger wide
note: A live app's text was set in the pixel sizes the brain wrote (16 to 24 px) beside stage words of 34 px, about half their size; and a frame scaled down to fit its room made targets smaller than a finger. The host now gives an app the stage's sizes (--font-body, --font-small, --font-title, --tap-min), and raises text set below the stage's small size and targets below the tap size, as shown on screen.

turns.say: make me a quick interactive maths question with answer buttons
